user.description: Sign in with your Pentair Home account credentials. See the [documentation]({documentation_url}) if you need help.

reconfigure.description: Update the credentials for this Pentair Home account.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Pentair Home
reauth_confirm.description: The credentials for {username} are no longer valid. Please re-enter the password to restore access.

abort.already_configured: This Pentair Home account is already configured.

data_description.heating_pump_program: The heater only fires while a pump runs. When you turn the heater on or start a heater timer and the pump is stopped, this program runs. After the heater turns off and cools down, the pump is stopped and its schedules resume. Pick a program that isn't set to run on a schedule.

update_failed.message: Failed to update data from Pentair Cloud.

command_failed.message: Pentair Cloud did not accept the command.

pump_alarm.message: The pump reports alarm {alarm}. Clear it in the Pentair app, then try again.

program_runs_on_schedule.message: {program} is set to run on a schedule. Press Resume pump schedules to let it run.

heater_command_failed.message: Pentair Cloud did not accept the heater command.

heater_service_mode.message: The controller is in service mode. Heater changes are blocked until it returns to normal operation.

heater_timer_out_of_range.message: The heater timer must be between {min} minute and {max} days.

reload_data.name: Reload data
reload_data.description: Force an immediate REST poll of the Pentair Cloud API.

start_heater_timer.name: Start heater timer
start_heater_timer.description: Run the pool heater for a set time, then turn it off. Turns the heater on if it is off. Turning the heater off cancels the timer.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the heater runs, from 1 minute to 30 days.
